subject: Schedule technical deep dive — Medlytics / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medlytics.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Schedule technical deep dive — Medlytics / Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Medlytics' ingestion patterns and the latency requirements for your real-time inference pipeline. As discussed, next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra team so we can:

- Walk through your current architecture and data flows
- Align on latency & throughput targets, and sequence lengths
- Evaluate integration options (API vs. Dedicated/Private deployment)
- Discuss authentication, logging, and SOC 2-related controls

Proposed attendees from our side: Dylan (Solutions Engineer) and Chloe (Infra PM). Could you confirm the right folks on your side (ML/infra, SRE, data infra)?

Tentative slots from our side next week (all PT):
- Wed 23 Jun, 9:00–10:30am
- Wed 23 Jun, 2:00–3:30pm
- Thu 24 Jun, 11:00am–12:30pm

If none of those work, share a couple times that do and we’ll align. I’ve attached a short agenda and a very high-level list of info it would be great if you could share beforehand (data volumes, avg/peak token lengths, current hosting).

Thanks — I’ll follow up once we lock time with a calendar invite and agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: redwood_technical_deep_dive_agenda.pdf, SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0400

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the agenda.

I’ll loop in our ML lead (Anita Kumar) and SRE (Roberto Diaz) — copying Priya for visibility. Anita is available Wednesday morning PT but not in the afternoon. Roberto prefers late morning or early afternoon.

Wed 23 Jun, 9:00–10:30am PT works for Anita and me. Can we hold that slot? Also please include any specifics you’d like us to share ahead of time so Anita can pull the right logs/configs.

On the SOC2 questionnaire — we’ll start filling the relevant sections but can discuss the cert scope during the call.

Jordan
Director of ML Infrastructure
Medlytics
jordan.lee@medlytics.ai

Marissa — 9:00–10:30am PT on Wed the 23rd works for me. I’ll cover the model serving options, expected throughput optimization, and what telemetry/logs we’ll want from their side.

Proposed agenda items to add:
- Current model architecture (frameworks, quantization if any)
- Typical and peak token lengths + request distribution
- Existing autoscaling and batching behavior
- Retention/observability needs (KV cache, tracing IDs)

I’ll prepare a quick slide with example telemetry we usually ask for and a checklist of config items for our infra team to review ahead of the call.

Thanks — see you on Wed.

Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
